newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed more than 19 points lower on Sunday after investors booked profits on a wide range of scrips that had advanced recently, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) lost 19.08 points or 1.57 percent at 1,197.60 on a turnover of 72.3 million taka. Of 137 issues traded, 86 lost and 49 gained.
Brokers said the market was awaiting the national budget for 1997-98 fiscal year (July-June), to be announced on June 12, and was likely to be mixed till then.
Beximco Pharma lost 3.48 taka to 164.89, and Chittagong Cement Klinker shed 190.12 to 2,046.68.
